source_notes: Phase 4 expansion (broke ground June 2025, op. 2029) adds 新增接卸能力325万吨/年 = 3.25 mtpa (one new 200,000 m3 tank, +17.5 MMcm/d gasification). GEM lists Phase 4 = 6.5 mtpa, which appears to be an error. Official English Nantong gov release: expansion brings TOTAL terminal capacity to 10 mtpa; Chinese provincial/municipal gov give the increment as 3.25 mtpa. (A CNPC newsroom article corroborates but failed the URL gate with HTTP 000, so it was dropped; the two government URLs above both PASS the verifier.) NOTE the base-total tension below (see qa): if Phase 4 increment is 3.25 and the post-expansion total is 10, GEM's existing Phase1-3 sum (3.5+3.0+3.5=10.0) may itself overstate the base — left untouched (operating units, separate anchor-year sourcing). Flagged yellow because it contradicts an existing GEM value and the base-total reconciliation is unresolved.
scope_note: Unit-level field (Capacity is per-unit in GEM). CapacityinMtpa (computed) would follow but is left for the human/recalc.
